description: This Java source file defines a dummy implementation of a CredentialsService for the Eclipse Hono project, providing hashed password credentials for testing or placeholder purposes.

classes.name: DummyCredentialsService
classes.description: A final class implementing CredentialsService that provides a static hashed password and returns credentials with this hash.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Overloaded method to retrieve credentials, either with or without client context, returning a CredentialsResult with a hashed password.

methods.name: getBase64EncodedSha256HashForPassword
methods.description: Generates a Base64-encoded SHA-256 hash of the provided password.
